memory_candidates: When a plan re-annotates a pre-existing sorry as 'strategic' with a follow_up_task, match the file's existing annotation convention exactly (assumption/why-deferred/follow-up prose block) rather than inventing a new comment shape -- consistency lets a future reader recognize the pattern instantly across DP-rows.

A no-task-references-in-deliverables lint hook will block bare 'task N' citations inside Lean source comments (outside specs/**); the established workaround in this codebase is to cite a durable in-plan anchor (a DP-row label like 'DP-5, see the plan's Planned Strategic Sorries table') instead of the raw task number, exactly as the pre-existing DP-2 annotation already does.

When two sorries in different files are blocked on 'the same fact at different formula shapes' (e.g. atom vs. implication persistence), record that unification explicitly in both files' comments and in the plan's sorry table, so a future task scoping a fix does not rediscover the connection from scratch or accidentally fix only one shape.
